turns.text: I was listening to my friend speak and couldn't hear him clearly because the music in the background was too loud, but later when the music stopped and the whole cafe went silent, I could hear his words perfectly. It's like our brains have this filter that lets us hear what's being said when it's easy to hear, but blocks it out when there's too much background noise, right? That's how some people can learn a new language in just a few seconds, isn't it?
